messages:
auditor-jen: Hi all — auditor requested SOC 2 evidence for ephemeral KMS keys used in our envelope encryption. They want creation/rotation events, caller identity for rotations, correlated request_ids/timestamps, and 2 live decrypt playbacks + 1 offline artifact from last 90 days. Any redaction constraints?

elaine: We can pull Cloud KMS admin logs + IAM audit logs. For playback we can either run live decrypt in staging (preferred) or hand over wrapped-key + decrypt logs. Live decrypt requires PII approval.

raj: Confirm sample size — auditor said 2 live + 1 artifact. That fits our usual 3-sample acceptance.

kevin: Notes: envelope flow = GenerateDataKey -> service wraps data key -> store wrapped key + ciphertext in GCS. Correlate app request_id with audit log protoPayload.requestMetadata.requestAttributes.requestId.

kevin: Example log query (GCP): resource.type="k8s_container" protoPayload.methodName:("GenerateDataKey" "Decrypt") protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"svc-prod@redwood" timestamp>="2025-12-01T00:00:00Z"

elaine: Proposed playback runbook (high level):
1) Run log query, pick 3 request_ids (2 live, 1 artifact-only).
2) Copy ciphertext objects to a staging bucket with restricted ACLs.
3) Verify envelope metadata -> key name + version.
4) Create short-lived staging service account with roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter scoped to the specific key version (4h).
5) Execute decrypt from staging harness (no prod network), record redacted output (metadata only, no plaintext).
6) Export Cloud Audit Logs showing Decrypt calls with matching request_id and timestamps.

elaine: Commands we use (examples):
# export decrypt logs
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"staging-decrypter@redwood"' --limit=50
# run staging decrypt
python tools/kms_playback.py --bucket gs://redwood-staging --object app-messages/2025/12/<id>.enc --kms-key projects/redwood/.../cryptoKeyVersions/1 --service-account staging-decrypter@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com

auditor-jen: Auditor follow-ups: (1) Provide IAM grant timeline (who granted the role and when). (2) Proof the staging SA had only the decrypter role and no other perms. (3) Retention plan and confirmation that staging copies will be scrubbed after demo.

raj: We'll include IAM Audit Logs for the binding event and snapshot the IAM policy at playback time.

kevin: To avoid exposing plaintext, we can provide sha256 hash of plaintext recorded at encryption time for verifier to match decrypted output (without seeing plaintext). Auditors usually accept redacted playback + logs.

ops-bot: export-job scheduled: playback-export-1824301111 ETA 25m.

auditor-jen: Thanks — please attach runbook, export manifest, IAM grant timeline, redacted recording, and scrub ticket link. Target 48h. Ping if legal/PII approval blocks.
